UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public social networking profile for a user on Pulse Social (strictly non-PII).

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Public display name shown on posts, comments, and friend lists (1-60 chars).

bio.description: Short biography or status tagline (0-300 chars).

avatarTheme.description: Color palette identifier for avatar styling (1-30 chars).

coverTheme.description: Banner theme identifier for profile cover (1-30 chars).

visibility.description: Visibility of the public directory profile.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Post.title: Post
Post.description: A real-time news feed post authored by a user.

authorId.description: UID of the user who created the post.

authorName.description: Display name of the post author (1-60 chars).

authorHandle.description: Handle of the post author (1-40 chars).

authorAvatarTheme.description: Avatar theme key of the author (1-30 chars).

content.description: Main text body of the post (1-2000 chars).

feeling.description: Optional feeling or activity badge (0-60 chars).

mediaPreset.description: Visual card banner preset or attached photo URI (0-500 chars).

category.description: Post category for news feed filtering.

visibility.description: Audience visibility level of the post.

likesCount.description: Total number of reactions/likes on the post.

commentsCount.description: Total number of comments on the post.

likedByUids.description: Bounded list of up to 50 user UIDs who reacted to the post.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when post was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when post was updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: A comment on a news feed post.

postId.description: ID of the parent post document.

authorName.description: Display name of the comment author (1-60 chars).

authorAvatarTheme.description: Avatar theme key of the comment author (1-30 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when comment was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Friendship.title: Friendship
Friendship.description: A friend request or active friend connection between two users.

requesterId.description: UID of the user who initiated the friend request.

requesterName.description: Display name of the requester (1-60 chars).

requesterBio.description: Short bio of the requester (0-200 chars).

requesterAvatarTheme.description: Avatar theme of the requester (1-30 chars).

receiverId.description: UID of the user receiving the friend request.

receiverName.description: Display name of the receiver (1-60 chars).

receiverBio.description: Short bio of the receiver (0-200 chars).

receiverAvatarTheme.description: Avatar theme of the receiver (1-30 chars).

memberUids.description: Two-element array containing [requesterId, receiverId] for relational list queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when request was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when friendship status was updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/posts/{postId}.description: News feed posts visible to public or friends.

/posts/{postId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Comments subcollection on a specific news feed post.

/friendships/{friendshipId}.description: Friend connections and pending friend requests scoped to memberUids.
